item.title: Iran criticizes Grossi’s double standard in condemning attack on nuclear facilities
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — The Iranian delegation in Vienna has criticized the double standard employed by the Director General of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) Rafael Grossi regarding the condemnation of attacks on nuclear facilities, saying that when Iranian facilities were bombed, Grossi deemed issuing a condemnation to be outside the scope of his mandate.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86317340/Iran-criticizes-Grossi-s-double-standard-in-condemning-attack

Tehran, IRNA —  The Iranian delegation in Vienna has criticized the double standard employed by the Director General of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) Rafael Grossi regarding the condemnation of attacks on nuclear facilities, saying that when Iranian facilities were bombed, Grossi deemed issuing a condemnation to be outside the scope of his mandate.

item.title: IRGC commander: Iranian Armed Forces disrupted enemy calculations

item.title: Senior commander: Iran will give immediate, firm, and powerful response to any level of threat
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Commander of the Iranian Army’s Ground Forces Brigadier General Ali Jahanshahi saying that the Army Ground Force is prepared to counter any type of threat, added that this force is ready to deliver an immediate, firm, and powerful response—with greater intensity than ever before—to any level of threat.

item.title: Transfer of enriched uranium out of Iran ‘off the table’, FM spox says
